manualpage.title: a2md - Show and manipulate Apache Managed Domains

summary.p: The a2md utility can be used to configure and update managed domains with the mod_md module for Apache HTTP Server. Managed Domains are virtual hosts which automatically obtain and renew TLS certificates from an ACME server.

dl.dd: The url of the ACME server directory
Directory for file data
Print usage information
Produce JSON output
Use the HTTP proxy url
Produce less output
You agree to the terms of services (url)
Produce more output
Print version

section.title: ACME server commands
section.p: Play with the ACME server. For most of the commands you need to specify the url of the ACME server directory.

dl.dd: Register a new account at ACME server with given contact-uri (email)
Delete an existing ACME account
Agree to ACME terms of service
Request a new authorization for an account and domain
Validate account existence

section.title: Managed domain addition
section.p: Adds a new managed domain. Must not overlap with existing domains.

section.title: Updating managed domain

p.code: a2md update name [opts] {domains | ca | account | contacts | agreement}

section.p: Update a managed domain's properties, where name belongs to managed domain which will be updated.
URL of ACME server can be also updated if -a|--acme option is present.

dl.dd: Update domain where dname is domain name which will be updated.
The URL where the CA offers its service. Currently only the ACME (LetsEncrypt) proto is implemented.
Account name on corresponding ACME server.
Contact address which will be used by ACME server to inform about renewals or changed terms of service.
URI pointing to terms of service of ACME server.

section.title: Drive managed domains
section.p: Drive all or the mentioned managed domains toward completeness

dl.dd: Which challenge type to use
Force driving the managed domain, even when it seems valid
Reset any staging data for the managed domain
Add a new managed domain dns with all the additional domain names
Remove the managed domains name from the store. When -f or --force option is specified, force managed domain removal - be silent about missing domains
List all managed domains in the store
If domains cmd is specified followed by one or more domains, MD store will be updated with those domains. The URL of the ACME server can be also updated if -a or --acme option is present.
